description: Test suite for task-related API endpoints in a collaborative project management platform, using pytest and httpx for asynchronous testing.

methods.name: _register_get_token(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Asynchronous helper to register a user and obtain an access token and organization ID.

methods.name: _create_project(client: AsyncClient, token: str, name: str = "P1")
methods.description: Asynchronous helper to create a new project with a given name and return its ID.

methods.name: test_list_tasks_requires_auth(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Test to ensure listing tasks without authentication returns 401 Unauthorized.

methods.name: test_create_list_update_delete_task_flow(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Test the full CRUD flow for tasks, including creation, listing, updating status, and deletion.

methods.name: test_org_isolation_on_tasks(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Ensure task operations are isolated by organization, preventing cross-organization access and modifications.

methods.name: test_reorder_tasks_basic_flow(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Test reordering of tasks within a project.

methods.name: test_tasks_filters_and_validation(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Test filtering tasks by status and validation behavior when creating tasks.

ctags.name: _create_project
ctags.pattern: /^async def _create_project(client: AsyncClient, token: str, name: str = "P1"):$/
